text:
alex: Hey folks — need a short break-glass/admin elevation to pull raw logs for a PII redaction follow-up. JIRA PRIV-4521.
I need read access to s3://prod-logs/2026-05-09/* and console sudo to run a filtered export. Window: 2 hours starting 2026-05-10 10:30 PST. 
Can someone advise approval path? @sarah @jamie

sarah: Please include exact commands you plan to run and confirm no KMS unwrapping required. Also we require session recording + audit notes.

alex: Commands are just a few grep/pg_dump and an aws s3 cp of a specific prefix, e.g.:
```
# list then copy small slice
aws s3 ls s3://prod-logs/2026-05-09/ | grep user123
aws s3 cp s3://prod-logs/2026-05-09/user123.gz ./
psql -c "\copy (select * from events where user_id='user123') to stdout with csv" > user123.csv
```
No KMS unwrapping — logs already accessible via KMS key policy for read with our role.
JIRA ticket (PRIV-4521) has the customer request and redaction rules.

jamie: Ok, that sounds scoped. Two asks before approval: 1) add the minimal s3 prefix in the request (not whole bucket), 2) set expiry to 2h and restrict src IP to our VPN. Can you confirm both?

alex: Confirmed — prefix s3://prod-logs/2026-05-09/user123/; will use office VPN (10.12.0.0/16). Set expiry 2h.

li: oncall here — I can grant ephemeral elevation if sec team signs off. Please use the elev CLI once granted. Example command I'll issue (for audit):
```
elev grant --user alex --scope s3:read,console:sudo --resource "arn:aws:s3:::prod-logs/2026-05-09/user123/*" --expires 2h --ip-restrict 10.12.0.0/16 --notes "PRIV-4521 redaction follow-up"
```
Will also enable session recording and attach JIRA link.

sec-bot: Audit note: elevation request received for alex (PRIV-4521). Waiting manual approval from @sarah and @jamie.

sarah: I approve with conditions above. Ensure logs copy stays on our secure bucket and delete after redaction. :white_check_mark:

jamie: approved. add me as watcher on the session.

li: Granted ephemeral elevation id=gr-88c3f9. Start time 1769991600 (10:30 PST). Expiry 2h. Session recording enabled: https://audit.redwood/incoming/gr-88c3f9

alex: Thanks — starting now. Will post once export done and confirm deletion.

sec-bot: Audit event logged: elevation.grant(gr-88c3f9) by li; approvers [sarah, jamie]; jira=PRIV-4521.

alex: Done — exported the slice, uploaded to s3://sec-temp-exports/PRIV-4521/user123.csv, redaction run, and original copy deleted from local. Will close the ticket after verification.

li: Verified session logs present. Elevation expired automatically. Closing the grant.

jamie: thanks for quick turnaround. please paste the redaction rule you ran in the JIRA so we have testable steps.

alex: Will add redaction snippet to PRIV-4521 shortly. :thumbsup:
